mapper.sql: id, name, size, path, ext, owner_id, dept_id, delete_flag, created_by, created_dt, updated_by, updated_dt
mapper.insert: insert into dms_attachment(id, name, size, path, ext, owner_id, dept_id, delete_flag, created_by, created_dt, updated_by, updated_dt) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{size}, #{path}, #{ext}, #{ownerId}, #{deptId}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{createdDt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedDt})
mapper.update: update dms_attachment set delete_flag = -1 , updated_by = #{updatedBy} , updated_dt = #{updatedDt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from dms_attachment where delete_flag = 1
limit 1
